body.message:
Just to clarify my question: I will be leaving the apartment after 7:00 PM tonight.

Will someone from your team be available at that time to meet me, collect the access cards, and do the check-out inspection?

Or does your team finish earlier? If no one is available after 7 PM, please let me know what I should do with the access cards and how the inspection will be handled.

Thank you.
